position_outside: UN/LOCODE places Alexandria on the city centre (31.1833, 29.9167), by the Eastern Harbour about 3 km east of the cargo port. Cargo ships call at the Western Harbour.

properties.source: Derived: the convex hull of this port's terminals from OpenStreetMap, grown by 300 m, then cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it (the sea within its coastline, rivers, docks and basins), with the terminals kept whole
properties.note: OpenStreetMap maps no port limits for Alexandria. These are the hull of the container terminal grown by 300 m, cut to the water OpenStreetMap maps inside it, with the terminal kept whole and a 30 m margin where it meets the water: the container terminal and the Western Harbour water off its quays. The rest of the port, which OpenStreetMap maps as one port-wide area of quays, sheds and yards, is left out with El Mina and the districts behind it. A scan of OpenStreetMap finds no homes, residential land, schools, hospitals, places of worship or named places inside.

properties.name: Container Terminal
properties.note: Mapped as Container Terminal. Two companies run container berths in the port, Alexandria Container and Cargo Handling Company and Hutchison's Alexandria International Container Terminals; OpenStreetMap does not say which this is, so no operator is set.
